subject: gk
question:
Which of the following pairs of "player - sports" is correct?

I. Vicky Ostwal - Cricket

II. Anshu Malik - Wrestling
solution:
Correct Answer **Both I and II**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Vicky Ostwal:**

 
• **Vicky Ostwal** is an** Indian cricketer **who plays for the **Maharashtra cricket team **and the** Delhi Capitals** in the **Indian Premier League (IPL).**
 
• He is a **left-arm orthodox spinner** and a **right-handed batsman.**
 
• Member of the **India U-19** team that won the **2022 Under-19 Cricket World Cup**
 
• Leading wicket-taker for India in the** 2022 Under-19** Cricket World Cup, with **12 wickets in six matches.**
 
• Named in the** ICC's Most Valuable Team** of the **2022 Under-19 Cricket World Cup**
 
• Bought by the **Delhi Capitals **for** ₹20 lakhs** in the** 2023 IPL auction.**

**Anshu Malik:**

 
• **Anshu Malik** is an **Indian freestyle wrestler** who won the silver medal in the **women's 57 kg **event at the **2021 World Wrestling Championships **held in **Oslo, Norway.**
 
• She is the first Indian wrestler to win a silver medal at the World Championships in the women's division.
 
• **Silver medal **at the **2021 World Wrestling Championships.**
 
• **Bronze medal** at the **2020 Asian Wrestling Championships.**
 
• **Silver medal** at the **2020** **Matteo Pellicone Ranking Series.**
 
• **Gold medal** at the **2016** **Cadet Wrestling Championships.**
 
• **Silver medal** at the **2018 Junior Wrestling Championships.**
 
• Malik is a recipient of the **Arjuna Award in 2021, India's highest sporting honor.**
 
• She is also a member of the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme**, a government program that supports India's top athletes.
